source: This curry is way too spicy for me.
target: This curry's fire rages far beyond what I can endure.

source: We didn't get the extra cheese we paid for.
target: We paid the price for extra cheese… and it never found its way to us.

source: Unless you're starving, let's wait for Grace before eating.
target: Unless hunger already ravages you, let us await Grace before we feast.

source: Grab 1 kg of tomatoes from the vegetable stall, would you?
target: Claim one kilogram of tomatoes from the vegetable stall, if you would.

source: Breakfast was just toast today, no time for anything else.
target: Today, toast alone stood as my breakfast. Time granted me nothing more.

source: The pani puri stall near the park closes at 9.
target: At nine, the pani puri stall near the park closes its doors to all who seek it.

source: I've got a bad cold, so I'm skipping the gym today.
target: A fierce cold has seized my body. Today, the gym shall be forsaken.

source: I barely slept last night, maybe three hours.
target: Sleep barely visited me last night, granting me perhaps three hours.

source: My head hurts. Can you turn the music down?
target: Pain has taken hold of my head. Will you lower the music?

source: I'm too tired to go out tonight, sorry Zoya.
target: Forgive me, Zoya. Weariness weighs too heavily upon me to venture out tonight.

source: If my fever doesn't go down by tomorrow, I'll see a doctor.
target: If this fever has not retreated by tomorrow, I shall seek the counsel of a doctor.

source: Can't keep my eyes open. Going to bed early.
target: My eyes refuse to remain open. I shall retire to my bed early.

source: Mom has a sore throat, so please don't make cold drinks.
target: A soreness has taken hold of Mom's throat. Prepare no cold drinks, I ask of you.

source: I took a nap at 3 and woke up at 6.
target: At three, I yielded to a nap… and did not rise again until six.

source: Did you take your medicine after lunch?
target: Tell me, did you take your medicine after the midday meal?

source: I feel dizzy whenever I stand up too fast.
target: Whenever I rise too swiftly, dizziness seizes me.

source: Vikram is sick and won't be coming to football on Sunday.
target: Illness has struck Vikram down. He shall not come to football on Sunday.

source: I'm sleepy but I still have two chapters to read.
target: Sleep calls to me, yet two chapters still await my reading.

source: Please wake me up at 6:30 if I don't hear the alarm.
target: Should the alarm fail to reach my ears, rouse me at six thirty, I ask of you.

source: My back has been aching since Tuesday.
target: Since Tuesday, an ache has made its home in my back.

source: Is the pharmacy downstairs open after 10?
target: Does the pharmacy downstairs keep its doors open beyond ten?

source: I don't think I can work today, my stomach is upset.
target: My stomach is in turmoil. I do not believe I can labor this day.

source: Lucas has been coughing all night. Should we call the doctor?
target: Through the entire night, coughing has gripped Lucas. Shall we summon the doctor?

source: Just woke up, give me ten minutes to get ready.
target: I have only now risen from sleep. Grant me ten minutes to prepare myself.

source: I need a long nap before the party.
target: Before the party begins, I must surrender to a long nap.

source: Stop worrying, I'm feeling much better than yesterday.
target: Cast aside your worry. I am far better today than I was yesterday.

source: Sneha wants the review shifted to Thursday. Is that fine?
target: Sneha seeks to move the review to Thursday. Does this meet with your approval?

source: My manager wants the slides by 5 today.
target: My manager demands the slides by five o'clock this very day.

source: I'm on leave next Monday, so please don't book any calls.
target: Next Monday, I shall be away on leave. Book no calls for me, if you would.

source: The client hasn't signed off on the design yet.
target: The client has yet to grant approval to the design.

source: Who's presenting first at the 11 o'clock meeting?
target: At the eleven o'clock meeting, who shall be the first to present?

source: If Omar approves the budget, we can hire two interns.
target: Should Omar grant his approval to the budget, we may bring two interns into our ranks.

source: I've sent the report twice and still no reply from HR.
target: Twice now I have sent the report… and still HR answers with silence.

source: Our standup is cancelled today because half the team is out.
target: Today's standup shall not take place, for half the team is absent.

source: Could you review my pull request before lunch?
target: Will you review my pull request before lunch is upon us?

source: I can't join the 2 pm call, I have a doctor's appointment.
target: The call at two in the afternoon shall proceed without me, for a doctor's appointment demands my presence.

source: The deadline got pushed to the 20th, thank goodness.
target: Fortune has shown us mercy. The deadline now rests upon the twentieth.

source: Don't reply-all to that email, just message me directly.
target: Do not reply to all upon that email. Send your words to me directly, and to no one else.

source: Ishaan is new, so please show him how the system works.
target: Ishaan has newly joined our ranks. Guide him through the workings of the system, if you would.

source: I'm working from home tomorrow unless the boss says otherwise.
target: Unless the boss commands otherwise, my work tomorrow shall be done from home.

source: Our floor's printer jammed again and ate my pages.
target: Again the printer on our floor has seized up… and devoured my pages whole.

source: 40 tickets are still open and the sprint closes on Friday.
target: Forty tickets still stand open, and the sprint shall close on Friday.

source: Can someone take notes? I'll be chairing the call.
target: I shall preside over the call. Who among you will record the notes?

source: My laptop died in the middle of the demo. So embarrassing.
target: My laptop perished in the very midst of the demo. Such shame.

source: The interview went okay, I guess, but I'm not sure.
target: The interview passed acceptably, I suppose… yet certainty eludes me.

source: Please send me the invoice for 15,000 rupees by Wednesday.
target: Send me the invoice for fifteen thousand rupees before Wednesday is done, if you would.

source: Nobody showed up to the training session at 4.
target: Not a single soul appeared for the training session at four.

source: When the new hire joins, give her a desk near the window.
target: When the new hire joins our ranks, grant her a desk beside the window.

source: Why does every meeting with sales run over by half an hour?
target: Why must every meeting with sales stretch half an hour beyond its appointed end?

source: Promise I'll send the draft to Meghna tonight.
target: I give you my word: Meghna shall have the draft tonight.

source: Ask Chen if he can cover my shift on Saturday.
target: Seek out Chen, and ask whether he can take my shift on Saturday.

source: The office Wi-Fi won't work until IT fixes the router.
target: Until IT restores the router, the office Wi-Fi shall remain lifeless.

source: Let's not schedule anything after 6, people want to go home.
target: Let us schedule nothing beyond six. Our people long to return to their homes.

source: Can you approve my leave for the 3rd and 4th of next month?
target: Will you grant my leave for the third and fourth of next month?

source: Whose turn is it to take out the trash?
target: To whom does the burden of the trash fall this time?

source: Please water the plants while I'm away for the weekend.
target: While I am away this weekend, tend to the plants and give them water, if you would.

source: The dryer is rattling like crazy again.
target: Once again, the dryer rattles as though possessed.

source: Kabir, stop throwing your socks under the sofa.
target: Kabir, your socks shall no longer be flung beneath the sofa. Stop this.

source: I vacuumed the living room, but the kitchen is still dirty.
target: I have vacuumed the living room, yet filth still reigns in the kitchen.

source: Can you fold the laundry if you get home before me?
target: Should you reach home before me, will you fold the laundry?

source: The bathroom tap won't stop dripping since Sunday.
target: Since Sunday, the bathroom tap has dripped without rest.

source: We need to call the plumber before the guests arrive on Friday.
target: We must summon the plumber before Friday brings our guests to the door.

source: I spent 3 hours cleaning the garage today.
target: This day, I surrendered three hours to cleaning the garage.

source: Hand wash the cast iron pan, it can't go in the dishwasher.
target: The cast iron pan must be washed by hand. The dishwasher is forbidden to it.

source: Has the dog been walked yet, or should I take him?
target: Has the dog had his walk yet, or shall I lead him out myself?

source: Sweep the balcony when the dust storm is over.
target: Once the dust storm has passed, sweep the balcony clean.

source: Nisha said she'll do the dishes tonight, not me.
target: Nisha has declared that tonight the dishes are her burden, not mine.

source: The bathroom bulb went out, and we don't have a spare.
target: The bathroom bulb has died, and no spare remains in our possession.

source: Could you iron my shirt? I have an interview at 10.
target: Will you iron my shirt? At ten, an interview awaits me.

source: Let's throw out the expired stuff in the fridge.
target: Let us cast out the expired remnants lurking in the fridge.

source: If the maid doesn't come tomorrow, we'll split the cleaning.
target: Should the maid not come tomorrow, we shall divide the cleaning between us.

source: I've changed the bedsheets, so don't sit on them with shoes.
target: I have changed the bedsheets. Sit not upon them with your shoes.

source: The gas cylinder is almost empty. Book a refill?
target: The gas cylinder is nearly spent. Shall we book a refill?

source: Tidy your room, Emma, before Grandma comes.
target: Emma, set your room in order before Grandma arrives.

source: Why are there dishes in the sink again?
target: Why do dishes lie abandoned in the sink once again?

source: The ceiling fan in the bedroom is wobbling badly.
target: The bedroom's ceiling fan wobbles violently upon its perch.

source: Mop the floor only after the paint dries.
target: Mop the floor only once the paint has dried, and not a moment before.

source: Recycling goes out at 8 tomorrow, I'll handle it.
target: The recycling goes out at eight tomorrow. That task, I shall claim as mine.

source: Please close the windows, the mosquitoes are coming in.
target: Close the windows, if you would. The mosquitoes are invading.

source: It's pouring outside, take an umbrella.
target: The heavens pour down outside. Take an umbrella with you.

source: It's 42 degrees today, I'm not stepping out.
target: Forty-two degrees scorch this day. I shall not set foot outside.

source: Will it rain during the match on Sunday?
target: Will the rain descend upon the match on Sunday?

source: The fog is so thick I can't see the road.
target: The fog hangs so thick that the road is lost to my sight.

source: If it's sunny tomorrow, let's dry the carpets on the terrace.
target: If the sun graces us tomorrow, let us lay the carpets out to dry on the terrace.

source: It's freezing in Delhi this week. Pack a jacket.
target: A bitter cold grips Delhi this week. Pack a jacket.

source: The storm knocked out our power around midnight.
target: Near midnight, the storm severed our power.

source: I don't think it'll snow before Christmas.
target: I do not believe the snow shall fall before Christmas arrives.

source: Is it too windy to fly the kite?
target: Does the wind rage too fiercely for the kite to take flight?

source: It hasn't rained in Chennai for three weeks.
target: For three weeks, Chennai has waited for rain… and none has fallen.

source: The humidity is unbearable, my clothes never dry.
target: The humidity is beyond endurance. My clothes refuse ever to dry.

source: Wear sunscreen, the UV index is 9 today.
target: The UV index stands at nine today. Shield yourself with sunscreen.

source: Hailstones dented the car roof last night.
target: Last night, hail battered the car and left its roof dented.

source: Bring the clothes in, it's going to rain any minute.
target: Bring the clothes inside. Rain shall descend at any moment.

source: The monsoon is late this year, the farmers are worried.
target: This year the monsoon tarries, and unease has gripped the farmers.

source: Would you fetch my passport photos from the studio near the temple?
target: My passport photos await at the studio near the temple. Will you bring them to me?

source: The shoes were 2,500 rupees, but I got them on sale.
target: The shoes cost two thousand five hundred rupees, yet fortune let me claim them on sale.

source: We need eggs, bread, and dish soap from the store.
target: We require provisions from the store: eggs, bread, and dish soap.

source: Don't buy the big pack, we won't finish it.
target: Leave the big pack where it lies. We shall not see its end.

source: I have to go to the bank before it closes at 4.
target: The bank closes its doors at four. I must reach it before then.

source: Riya, did you return the library books yet?
target: Riya, have the library books been returned to their keepers yet?

source: This jacket is too tight. Can I swap it for a large?
target: This jacket binds me far too tightly. May I trade it for one in large?

source: The pharmacy queue is huge, I'll be another 20 minutes.
target: The pharmacy queue stretches without end. Twenty more minutes shall pass before I am free.

source: Please get the receipt this time.
target: This time, do not depart without claiming the receipt.

source: Groceries came to 1,850 rupees this week.
target: This week, the groceries exacted a toll of one thousand eight hundred and fifty rupees.

source: Does the supermarket on MG Road open early on Sundays?
target: Does the supermarket on MG Road open early when Sunday comes?

source: I have to post this birthday card to Ammi by Thursday.
target: This birthday card must begin its journey to Ammi by Thursday.

source: Pay the electricity bill online, don't stand in the line.
target: Pay the electricity bill online. There is no need to stand in that line.

source: The tailor said my kurta will be ready on the 9th.
target: My kurta, the tailor tells me, shall be ready on the ninth.

source: Should I buy the blue sofa or the grey one?
target: The blue sofa or the grey one… which should I claim?

source: Hamid, could you drop off my suits at the dry cleaner?
target: Hamid, will you carry my suits to the dry cleaner?

source: Hurry, the 50 percent discount on headphones is over tonight.
target: Hurry, for tonight the fifty percent discount on headphones comes to its end.

source: I couldn't find the right charger anywhere in the mall.
target: I searched the entire mall, yet the right charger eluded me.

source: We'll get the new fridge when the old one finally dies.
target: Only when the old fridge finally breathes its last shall we bring home the new one.

source: Remind me to renew my gym membership on Monday.
target: Remind me, when Monday comes, to renew my gym membership.

source: My phone battery is at 5 percent, I might get cut off.
target: My phone clings to its last five percent. I may yet be cut off.

source: Our Wi-Fi disconnects every few minutes, it's driving me mad.
target: Every few minutes our Wi-Fi falls away… and my sanity goes with it.

source: Can you send the photos on email? WhatsApp isn't working.
target: WhatsApp has failed us. Will you send the photos by email instead?

source: The reset link for my email never arrives, I've tried five times.
target: Five times I have tried, yet the reset link for my email refuses to arrive.

source: Don't update your phone yet, the new version has bugs.
target: Do not update your phone just yet. Bugs plague the new version.

source: Aditya, is your laptop charger the same as mine?
target: Aditya, tell me… is your laptop charger the same as mine?

source: My screen cracked when I dropped the phone on the stairs.
target: The phone slipped from my grasp upon the stairs, and its screen was cracked.

source: If the call drops, I'll ring you back from the landline.
target: Should the call be lost, I shall reach you again from the landline.

source: The TV remote isn't responding, maybe it needs new batteries.
target: The TV remote no longer heeds me. Perhaps it hungers for new batteries.

source: Please restart the router, the internet is down.
target: The internet has gone dark. Restart the router, if you would.

source: I can't hear you, you're breaking up.
target: Your voice comes to me in fragments. I cannot hear you.

source: My storage is full, so I can't download the app.
target: My storage has reached its limit, and so the app cannot be downloaded.

source: Somebody logged out of Netflix on the TV, who was it?
target: Someone has logged out of Netflix on the TV. Who dared do this?

source: The printer at home only prints in pink now.
target: The printer at home now prints in pink, and pink alone.

source: Text me when you reach, my calls aren't going through.
target: My calls fail to reach you. When you arrive, send me a text.

source: The app crashed twice while I was paying the bill.
target: While I paid the bill, the app collapsed not once but twice.

source: Can you help me set up the new printer on Saturday?
target: Will you lend me your aid in setting up the new printer on Saturday?

source: My earphones only work in one ear.
target: Only one ear receives sound from my earphones.

source: Don't share the OTP with anyone, even if they say they're from the bank.
target: Reveal the OTP to no one, even those who claim to come from the bank.

source: The video call keeps freezing, let's switch to audio.
target: The video call freezes without end. Let us abandon it for audio.

source: Are we still on for bowling at 7 on Friday?
target: Is our bowling at seven on Friday still to be honored?

source: Sam and Tara are coming over to watch the match.
target: Sam and Tara shall join us here to watch the match.

source: Let's meet at the café near Koramangala at 5.
target: Let us gather at five, at the café near Koramangala.

source: I can't make it to the trip, my exams start that week.
target: The trip must go on without me, for my exams begin that very week.

source: If Neha's free, ask her to join us for dinner.
target: Should Neha be free, summon her to join us for dinner.

source: Who's bringing the snacks for movie night?
target: Who shall carry the snacks to movie night?

source: We're splitting the bill four ways, so it's 600 each.
target: We shall divide the bill four ways. Each of us owes six hundred.

source: Keep the surprise party a secret from Kiran, okay?
target: Kiran must not learn of the surprise party. Will you guard this secret?

source: Can we postpone the hike until the weekend after?
target: Shall we let the hike wait until the weekend after?

source: Javier booked the badminton court for 6 to 7 tomorrow.
target: Javier has claimed the badminton court for tomorrow, from six until seven.

source: I'm in for the concert, but I can't stay late.
target: Count me in for the concert. But I cannot linger late into the night.

source: Please send me the location, I've never been there.
target: Send me the location, if you would. That place is unknown to me.

source: Let's not go to that bar again, it was way too loud.
target: That bar was far too loud. Let us not set foot in it again.

source: Divya's birthday dinner is on the 14th, don't forget.
target: Divya's birthday dinner awaits on the fourteenth. Let it not slip from your memory.

source: Is anyone up for a game of cricket this evening?
target: Who among you will rise to a game of cricket this evening?

source: We'll go to the beach unless it's too hot.
target: We shall journey to the beach, unless the heat proves too fierce.

source: Haven't seen you in ages, let's catch up this weekend.
target: Ages have passed since our last meeting. Let us reunite this weekend.

source: Swing by and get me on your way to Aisha's place?
target: Will you come by and collect me on your way to Aisha's place?

source: Tom cancelled again, so it's just the three of us.
target: Tom has cancelled once more. It falls to the three of us alone.

source: Let me know by Wednesday if you want a ticket.
target: Should you desire a ticket, make it known to me by Wednesday.

source: Dad wants everyone home by 9 for the puja.
target: Dad desires everyone home by nine, for the puja awaits.

source: Can you call Nani? She's been asking about you.
target: Will you call Nani? She has been seeking word of you.

source: My brother took my bike again without asking.
target: Without asking, my brother has seized my bike yet again.

source: Please don't fight with your sister in front of guests.
target: I ask you, do not wage war with your sister in front of our guests.

source: Mom's flight lands at 10:45, who's picking her up?
target: Mom's flight descends at ten forty-five. Who shall go to receive her?

source: The kids have a holiday on Monday, so plan something fun.
target: Monday grants the kids a holiday. Plan something worthy of joy.

source: Uncle Raj is staying with us until the wedding.
target: Uncle Raj shall dwell among us until the wedding.

source: If Grandpa feels tired, we'll leave the party early.
target: Should weariness overtake Grandpa, we shall depart the party early.

source: My son scored 92 in maths and he's thrilled.
target: My son has conquered maths with ninety-two, and his joy knows no bounds.

source: Did you remember to call your mother on her birthday?
target: Did your mother hear your voice on her birthday? Did you remember to call?

source: Sara won't eat her vegetables unless we add cheese.
target: Unless cheese is added, Sara refuses her vegetables.

source: We're visiting my in-laws in Pune for three days.
target: For three days, we shall be guests of my in-laws in Pune.

source: The baby is teething and cried all night.
target: The baby is teething, and the cries endured all night long.

source: Ask your father before you take the car.
target: Seek your father's leave before you take the car.

source: My parents' anniversary is next Saturday, let's order a cake.
target: Next Saturday, my parents mark their anniversary. Let us order a cake in their honor.

source: Arnav, finish your homework before you turn on the TV.
target: Arnav, the TV stays dark until your homework is done.

source: My sister doesn't want a big party this year.
target: This year, my sister seeks no grand party.

source: Is Aunty Leela coming for lunch on Sunday?
target: Will Aunty Leela grace us for lunch on Sunday?

source: Grandma fell asleep during the movie again.
target: Once more, Grandma surrendered to sleep during the movie.

source: Tell the kids dinner is in 15 minutes.
target: Tell the kids that dinner shall be served in fifteen minutes.

source: I'm so bored, there's nothing to do this afternoon.
target: Boredom weighs upon me. This afternoon offers nothing to fill it.

source: Just got the job offer, I can't stop smiling!
target: The job offer has only now arrived… and this smile will not leave me!

source: I'm nervous about my driving test on Thursday.
target: My driving test approaches on Thursday, and nerves grip me.

source: Honestly, the neighbor's drilling is driving me crazy.
target: Honestly, the neighbor's drilling is tearing my sanity apart.

source: Why is everyone so grumpy today?
target: What ill humor has seized everyone today?

source: I'm in a great mood, let's go out for dessert.
target: My spirits soar. Let us venture out in search of dessert.

source: Don't talk to me until I've had my coffee.
target: Do not address me until coffee has passed my lips.

source: I'm a bit anxious, Lily hasn't replied since morning.
target: A quiet anxiety stirs within me. Lily has been silent since morning.

source: I'm annoyed that the parcel came broken.
target: The parcel arrived broken, and my irritation grows.

source: If one more person asks about my wedding, I'll scream.
target: Let one more person ask about my wedding… and I shall scream.

source: Feeling really happy today, the sun is finally out.
target: Great happiness fills me today. At last, the sun has shown itself.

source: I'm restless and can't focus on anything.
target: Restlessness consumes me. My mind will settle on nothing.

source: Are you upset with me, Dev?
target: Dev, does displeasure toward me weigh upon your heart?

source: I'm not mad at you, Pooja, just really tired.
target: Pooja, my anger is not directed at you. It is only a deep weariness that holds me.

source: So excited for the concert on the 22nd!
target: The concert on the twenty-second draws near, and excitement burns within me!

source: The metro is packed, I'll take the next one.
target: The metro is packed beyond bearing. I shall await the next one.

source: Our flight to Goa is at 6:20, so leave by 4.
target: Our flight to Goa takes to the sky at six twenty. Depart by four, and no later.

source: Did you pack the chargers and the passports?
target: Have the chargers and the passports been secured in your bags?

source: The highway is closed, so the bus is taking a longer route.
target: The highway has been sealed, and so the bus must take a longer path.

source: Book an Uber if the auto drivers refuse to go.
target: If the auto drivers deny us passage, book an Uber.

source: I'll be in Mumbai from Tuesday to Friday.
target: Mumbai shall claim me from Tuesday until Friday.

source: Can we stop for tea at the next dhaba?
target: Shall we pause for tea at the next dhaba we come upon?

source: The train to Jaipur doesn't have any seats left.
target: The train to Jaipur is full. Not a single seat remains.

source: Please keep the tickets safe until we board.
target: Guard the tickets with care, if you would, until we board.

source: My suitcase didn't arrive with the rest of the luggage.
target: The rest of the luggage arrived, yet my suitcase was not among it.

source: How many hours is the drive to Lonavala from here?
target: From here, how many hours must we endure on the road to Lonavala?

source: The toll on this road costs 120 rupees each way.
target: On this road, the toll claims one hundred and twenty rupees each way.

source: We missed the last ferry, so we're staying the night.
target: The last ferry has departed without us. Tonight, we shall remain here.

source: Nadia is driving, so I'll handle the music and directions.
target: Nadia shall take the wheel, so the music and the directions are mine to command.

source: Unless the road clears, we won't reach the hotel before dark.
target: Unless the road clears, darkness shall fall before we reach the hotel.

source: I need a cup of coffee to wake up.
target: I require a cup of coffee to rouse myself from slumber.

source: My phone battery is dying.
target: My phone's battery is dying, its strength fading.

source: I forgot my password again.
target: Once again, my password has slipped from my memory.

source: It's raining heavily outside.
target: The rain is pouring down outside, relentless and heavy.

source: I'm going to order pizza for dinner.
target: For dinner, I shall summon pizza.

source: I really need a vacation.
target: I truly require a vacation from my labors.

source: I'm heading to the gym now.
target: The gym awaits me. I depart now.

source: The Wi-Fi connection is terrible today.
target: Today, the Wi-Fi connection is a wretched thing.

source: I'm totally broke until payday.
target: My coffers stand empty, and so they shall remain until payday.

source: I need to buy some groceries.
target: I must go forth and acquire some groceries.

source: I have to clean my room today.
target: Today, I must restore order to my room.

source: It is way too hot today.
target: The heat today is far beyond what anyone should bear.

source: It's freezing in this room.
target: A freezing cold has taken hold of this room.

source: I'm going to sleep now. Goodnight.
target: I shall now surrender to sleep. Goodnight.

source: Great to see you again!
target: It gladdens me greatly to see you once more!

source: No, I can't do that.
target: No. This I cannot do.

source: Yes, let's do it.
target: Yes. Let us set it in motion.

source: Stop sending me emails.
target: Cease your emails. Send me no more.

source: My laptop just crashed.
target: My laptop has just crashed before my eyes.

source: Where is the nearest restroom?
target: Tell me, where might the nearest restroom be found?

source: I am preparing dinner.
target: I am at work preparing the evening's feast.

source: The light turned red.
target: The light now burns red. The way forward is barred.

source: This line is taking forever.
target: This line drags on without end. My patience wears thin.

source: The elevator is full.
target: The elevator is full… there is no room for another.

source: I left my wallet at home.
target: My wallet lies forgotten at home.

source: My alarm didn't go off.
target: My alarm stayed silent when it was meant to sound.

source: What time is it right now?
target: What hour is upon us at this moment?

source: I'm going to take a shower.
target: I shall go and cleanse myself beneath the shower.

source: I bought a lot of things online.
target: I have purchased a great many things through online markets.

source: Turn off that annoying alarm.
target: Put an end to that wretched alarm.

source: This isn't what I ordered.
target: What lies before me is not what I ordered.

source: My soup is cold.
target: My soup has lost all its warmth.

source: Can you lend me a hand?
target: Will you lend me your aid?

source: Finally finished my task!
target: At last, the task is done. My labor has reached its end.

source: Let's begin the project.
target: Let us set the project in motion.

source: Let's gather everyone for a meeting.
target: Let us summon everyone to gather for a meeting.

source: I have to cancel our plans.
target: I am forced to cancel our plans.

source: Can we meet tomorrow instead?
target: Might we meet when tomorrow comes, instead?

source: I have a terrible headache.
target: A terrible pain has seized my head.

source: I need to take my pill.
target: The time has come for my pill. I must take it.

source: Let's watch a movie tonight.
target: Tonight, let us surrender ourselves to a movie.

source: I watched the whole season in one day.
target: In a single day, I devoured the entire season.

source: I'm reading an interesting book.
target: I am reading a book that holds me firmly in its grasp.

source: This song is really good.
target: This song is truly magnificent. It commands my attention.

source: Please turn down the volume.
target: Lower the volume, if you would. There is no need for such force.

source: I can't hear what you're saying.
target: Your words do not reach me. I cannot hear them.

source: I dropped my phone on the floor.
target: My phone slipped from my grasp and struck the floor.

source: My screen is shattered.
target: My screen has been shattered to pieces.

source: I haven't had coffee yet.
target: Coffee has not yet touched my lips.

source: This dessert is too sweet.
target: The sweetness of this dessert is more than I can bear.

source: There is too much salt in this.
target: Salt has been poured into this without restraint.

source: This food is burning my mouth.
target: This food sets my mouth ablaze.

source: I need a glass of water.
target: I require a glass of water to quench this thirst.

source: The cab is outside.
target: The cab has arrived. It waits outside.

source: I missed the bus.
target: The bus has departed without me.

source: My flight got delayed.
target: My flight has been delayed… and I am left to wait.

source: I'm packing my luggage.
target: I am packing my luggage for the journey that awaits.

source: They lost my suitcase.
target: My suitcase has been lost by their hand.

source: I'd like to check into my room.
target: I wish to claim my room. Check me in, if you would.

source: My room key isn't working.
target: My room key refuses to grant me entry.

source: Can I get the check, please?
target: May I have the check? Bring it forth, if you would.

source: Keep the change.
target: Keep the change. It is yours to claim.

source: This item costs too much.
target: The price of this item is far too great.

source: This was a great deal!
target: A great bargain has been struck!

source: The item is sold out.
target: This item is sold out. None remain to be claimed.

source: I'm just looking around.
target: I am merely looking upon what is offered here.

source: Where is the fitting room?
target: Tell me, where is the fitting room to be found?

source: These pants are too small.
target: These pants are too small. They cannot contain me.

source: This shirt is way too big.
target: This shirt is far too big. It swallows me whole.

source: I have to do the dishes.
target: The dishes await. Their cleansing is my duty.

source: Take out the garbage.
target: Take out the garbage. Let it trouble us no longer.

source: I need to water my plants.
target: My plants thirst, and I must give them water.

source: The dog won't stop barking.
target: The dog barks without end and will not be silenced.

source: I'm going to walk the dog.
target: The dog awaits its walk, and I shall lead it.

source: The cat is purring.
target: The cat purrs in quiet contentment.

source: The lightbulb blew out.
target: The lightbulb has blown out. Its light has perished.

source: The sink is dripping.
target: The sink keeps dripping, drop by steady drop.

source: I need to cut the grass.
target: The grass has grown… and I must cut it.

source: I'm painting the living room.
target: I am painting the living room. Its walls shall wear a new color.

source: Putting this chair together is hard.
target: Putting this chair together is a trial of my patience.

source: I lost the manual.
target: The manual has vanished from my grasp.

source: The TV remote needs batteries.
target: The TV remote's power is spent. It requires new batteries.

source: Change the channel.
target: Banish this channel. Change it.

source: Look at the news.
target: Turn your eyes to the news.

source: I spent hours on my phone.
target: Hours slipped away from me as I stayed bound to my phone.

source: Let's take a photo together.
target: Let us stand together and capture this moment in a photo.

source: I uploaded a picture.
target: I have uploaded a picture. It now stands online.

source: My post got a lot of likes.
target: Many have shown their approval of my post through likes.

source: Someone left a mean comment.
target: Someone has left a cruel comment, and its malice is plain.

source: I blocked him.
target: I have blocked him from my sight.

source: My phone is updating.
target: My phone is in the midst of its update.

source: My phone storage is full.
target: My phone's storage is full. Not one more thing can it hold.

source: I'm deleting old photos.
target: I am purging my old photos, the remnants of days gone by.

source: I'm plugging in my phone.
target: I am plugging in my phone to restore its strength.

source: Put your phone on silent.
target: Put your phone on silent. Let no sound escape it.

source: Another spam caller.
target: Another spam caller has come to plague me.

source: I have 100 unread emails.
target: One hundred unread emails lie in wait for me.

source: I'm writing a quick text.
target: I am crafting a swift text.

source: I sent that message to the wrong group.
target: That message went astray… it reached the wrong group.

source: Autocorrect messed up my sentence.
target: Autocorrect has mangled my sentence.

source: Bless you!
target: Bless you, and be well!

source: Are you feeling sick?
target: Has sickness taken hold of you?

source: I think I'm getting sick.
target: I believe illness is beginning to claim me.

source: I have a high fever.
target: A high fever burns within me.

source: I have a doctor's appointment.
target: I have an appointment with the doctor that I must honor.

source: Drink this cough syrup.
target: Drink this cough syrup. Let it do its work.

source: I cut my finger.
target: A cut has wounded my finger.

source: I'm taking a 20-minute nap.
target: I shall surrender to a twenty-minute nap.

source: You look sleepy.
target: You appear weighed down by sleep.

source: I need to stretch my legs.
target: My legs demand to be stretched.

source: A warm cup of tea is nice.
target: A warm cup of tea brings comfort to the soul.

source: The cake is in the oven.
target: The cake rests within the oven, taking shape in its heat.

source: The food is burning!
target: The food is burning! Fire is consuming our meal!

source: My ice cream is melting.
target: My ice cream is melting away before my eyes.

source: Do you have gum?
target: Tell me, do you carry any gum?

source: Wash your hands before eating.
target: Before you eat, wash your hands clean.

source: Help me set the dinner table.
target: Lend me your aid in setting the dinner table.

source: Clear the plates.
target: Clear the plates from the table.

source: Put the leftovers in the fridge.
target: Place the leftovers in the fridge, so that nothing is wasted.

source: Make a list of what we need.
target: Write a list of all that we require.

source: The store is super crowded.
target: The store is overrun by a great crowd.

source: I'm using the self-checkout line.
target: I am using the self-checkout line, relying on no one but myself.

source: Do you want paper or plastic bags?
target: Paper or plastic… which bags shall carry your goods?

source: Do you want your receipt?
target: Do you wish to keep your receipt?

source: I want to return this product.
target: I wish to return this product from whence it came.

source: Give me my money back.
target: Give my money back to me, as is my due.

source: Is there a warranty on this?
target: Does a warranty stand behind this?

source: The car is running on empty.
target: The car runs on empty, its fuel all but spent.

source: I got a flat tire.
target: One of my tires has fallen flat.

source: We are stuck in heavy traffic.
target: Heavy traffic holds us in its grip. We cannot move.

source: Watch out for the speed camera.
target: Beware the speed camera. It watches all who pass.

source: Stop honking your horn!
target: Cease this endless honking of your horn!

source: I found a parking spot.
target: A parking spot has revealed itself to me.

source: Parallel parking is tough.
target: Parallel parking is a hard trial.

source: My car needs a wash.
target: My car is covered in grime and requires a wash.

source: Fasten your seatbelt.
target: Fasten your seatbelt. Your safety demands it.

source: The GPS is recalculating.
target: The GPS is recalculating, forging a new path.

source: I got a speeding ticket.
target: I have been punished with a speeding ticket.

source: Pay the toll.
target: Pay the toll that is demanded.

source: We're going on a long drive.
target: We shall embark upon a long drive, the open road before us.

source: We have arrived.
target: Our journey's end is reached.

source: Everything is in order now.
target: Order has been restored. All is as it should be.

source: I can accept a delay if you explain the reason and the new timeline.
target: I can accept a delay, provided you explain the reason and lay out the new timeline.

source: We need to make the process simpler for someone doing it for the first time.
target: We must make the process simpler for one who walks this path for the first time.

source: I want us to learn from the failure instead of hiding it.
target: I want us to learn from the failure instead of concealing it in shadow.

source: We cannot promise a date until the team confirms the estimate.
target: Until the team confirms the estimate, we cannot pledge any date.

source: I need the freedom to question the plan without being labelled negative.
target: I require the freedom to challenge the plan without being branded negative.

source: If the information is incomplete, we should say so clearly.
target: If the information stands incomplete, we ought to proclaim it plainly.

source: I will stand by you, but I won't lie for you.
target: I will stand beside you… but I will not speak falsehoods for you.

source: Let's separate what we know from what we are assuming.
target: Let us divide what we know from what we merely assume.

source: A good solution should still work when the original expert is unavailable.
target: A good solution should endure even when its original expert is beyond reach.

source: I want a fair outcome, even if it is not the outcome I hoped for.
target: I seek a fair outcome, even should it not be the one I hoped for.

source: Keep the original seal intact until the inspector arrives.
target: Let the original seal remain unbroken until the inspector has arrived.

source: If Leo is late again, start the meeting without him.
target: If Leo is late once more, do not wait for him. Begin the meeting.

source: I need the original file, not a screenshot.
target: I require the original file. A screenshot shall not suffice.

source: We have saved 18,000 rupees, but the repair will cost 22,000.
target: We have saved eighteen thousand rupees… yet the repair shall demand twenty-two thousand.

source: Do not give the spare medicine to anyone else.
target: Let the spare medicine pass into no one else's hands.

source: Once the guests arrive, please serve the food.
target: Once the guests have arrived, serve the food, if you would.

source: I will call the mechanic if the engine makes that noise again.
target: Should the engine utter that noise again, I shall summon the mechanic.

source: The blue folder belongs to Sana, while the green one is mine.
target: The blue folder is Sana's to claim, while the green one belongs to me.

source: I can take the 2:20 train, but not the 2:05 one.
target: I can board the two twenty train, but the two oh five is beyond me.

source: Please ask Farah before using her laptop.
target: Before you use Farah's laptop, seek her permission, if you would.

source: The water filter needs a new cartridge every six months.
target: Every six months, the water filter demands a new cartridge.

source: I did not receive the parcel that was marked delivered yesterday.
target: The parcel was marked delivered yesterday, yet it never reached my hands.

source: Unless both parents agree, the school trip form cannot be submitted.
target: Unless both parents give their consent, the school trip form cannot be submitted.

source: The technician will arrive between 11 am and noon.
target: Between eleven in the morning and noon, the technician shall arrive.

source: I would rather wait one day than send the wrong document.
target: I would rather endure a single day of waiting than send the wrong document.
